files.name: motion-prompt-033.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Rack focus" (ラックフォーカス), one of the names in "Camera moves & transitions".
Motion Prompt #033

What it is: Shift focus between near and far
What the sample shows: The camera does not move; focus shifts from a flower in the foreground to a person behind it, swapping which one is blurred.
Spec:
- Camera: position, direction and focal length all fixed (height 1.1 m); only the blur amounts change
- Blur: the foreground flower (0.75 m left, 2 m away) goes 0 px → 7 px; the person and background (person 0.9 m right, 9 m away) go 6 px → 0 px; the ground grid uses 0.6× the background blur
- Timing: 1.0 s to 2.6 s (1.6 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
- Focus marker: blue corner brackets travel in a straight line from the flower to the person, half-width shrinking 46 px → 30 px
- Subject: neither the flower nor the person moves
- Return: hold 2.6–4.2 s, then cross-fade back over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows focus distance (◎ 2m → ◎ 9m)
When to use it: To move attention from foreground to background (or back) without cutting.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/033.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/camera.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
